analysis_type: READ-ONLY FORENSIC ANALYSIS OF EXISTING ARTIFACTS

fifteen_questions_answers.q01_why_did_all_294_candidates_fail: 100% of candidates failed one of four sequential admission gates: Stop Bounds (129), Blended RR (72), HTF Context (59), or TP2 Geometry (34). Zero candidates survived to trade approval.
fifteen_questions_answers.q02_which_gate_was_encountered_most_ofte: STOP_TOO_WIDE at Gate 2 was the most frequent observed point of rejection (126 candidates, 42.86%). Combined with STOP_BELOW_MINIMUM (3), the Stop Bounds Gate accounted for 129 rejections (43.88%).
fifteen_questions_answers.q07_how_close_were_stop_failures_to_3_5_: 20 of 126 STOP_TOO_WIDE candidates (15.87%) were near misses within 3.50–4.00 ATR (closest was 3.5026 ATR). However, 71.43% (90/126) were materially excessive (> 4.50 ATR, reaching up to 26.89 ATR).
fifteen_questions_answers.q08_how_close_were_rr_failures_to_3_8_r: ZERO near misses. The maximum observed RR was 2.3790R. 100% of RR-rejected candidates had blended RR < 2.50R, representing a massive structural shortfall from 3.8R.
fifteen_questions_answers.q09_how_common_was_tp2_failure: 34 candidates (11.56%) failed TP2 geometry. All 34 had TP2 on the wrong side of TP1 (gap < 0). 7 candidates were close near misses within 0.5 price points.
fifteen_questions_answers.q10_how_many_candidates_are_objectively_: 27 candidates total: 20 Stop near misses (3.5–4.0 ATR) and 7 TP2 near misses (gap >= -0.5 pts). Zero RR near misses.
fifteen_questions_answers.q11_how_many_are_objectively_far_from_qu: 148 candidates (50.34%): 90 with stop > 4.5 ATR, 72 with RR < 2.5R, and 8 with TP2 inverted by > 5.0 points.
fifteen_questions_answers.q12_what_can_we_conclude_about_the_score: SCORE_BELOW_THRESHOLD = 0 because the score gate was never reached. Every candidate was rejected by an earlier gate in the sequence. No conclusions can be drawn about candidate quality from the score gate.
fifteen_questions_answers.q13_what_can_we_conclude_about_htf_rejec: 59 candidates (20.07%) were rejected immediately at Gate 1 due to HTF invalidity. Because D1/H4 sub-flags were not serialized, specific macro/trend conflict causes cannot be determined without a rerun.
fifteen_questions_answers.q14_what_information_remains_unavailable: 1. Numerical setup score (0/294). 2. D1 and H4 directional bias sub-flags (0/294). 3. Entry and stop prices for 93 candidates rejected before geometry assignment.
fifteen_questions_answers.q15_what_should_be_investigated_next: 1. The 20 Stop near misses (3.5–4.0 ATR) to examine if anchor logic or ATR scaling caused the boundary overrun. 2. The structural cause of low RR (<2.4R across all candidates) to understand target placement geometry. 3. HTF logging enhancement in future test runs.
